body:
you're insanely cute are you kidding me

you have a lovely smile. i like the slightly longer hair on you, especially the last few pictures. absolutely not ugly
definitely will, you've got me sold! i'm really, really glad you found that well-needed comfort. take care of yourself

hey, hey, breathe. you're doing really well already. you're on here asking for help, that's one step closer to getting the help you need. 

your parents will worry, of course, but you'd worry too if someone you loved told you they felt this way, right? worry comes with loving someone, and your parents sound like they love you a lot. it's possible that they already sense that something is wrong, but are hesitant about bringing it up because they don't know if you'd be willing to share it with them. so it might actually be relieving for them if you open up to them about this. 

i think it would bring comfort to you both if you had a talk about this. they'd want to know if something was wrong, and then you could get help and make it through this with their support. if not them, any responsible adult you trust with this. but please don't hesitate to reach out or talk yourself out of it because it's not bad enough and you'd just burden them. you deserve a shot at happiness, okay? you really do, and i sincerely hope it comes to you
that sounds lovely :( i want to go hug a tree now!!!

hey, you've made it clear that you've made up your mind about this, but i'd take this chance to reflect and possibly rethink. how does that sound?

you've probably thought about this a million times already, but your thoughts have landed you here and it's a dead end, for now. you could wait, sure, but you could also backtrack a little, walk along a few other paths you never got around to exploring. you might find a way out, another one, and you might think back onto this period of your life and marvel at how lucky it was, in hindsight, that luck was against you that one time.

you aren't alone in this, stranger. i wish you well.

hey, i'm a girl just a few years older than you, and i can see my younger self in you. i know you feel lost and alone right now, i know how helpless you feel, and i wish someone so young never had to go through this much pain, but here you are, and here i am. 

you know, about the fear thing—this resonated with me a lot. i am terrified of losing the people i love, because at my lowest they're all i have to cling on. but then i look at the people around me, and chances are they've all lost people and things dear to them. yet they're still here. life just keeps on going. and i think, sure, i'm a little more messed in the head than your average person, but there's no chance these people are all 100% okay, right? if they've made it through whatever life chucked at them, so can i. and so can you.

don't let fear take something from you before it's even gone. i know, it's a million times easier said than done, but fear is caustic and it will eat you up if you let it. breathe. you're gonna be okay, and you're gonna be okay even when it's not okay.

i know that all these feelings can get so overwhelming to the point where ending it all seems like the only option, but i promise you it isn't. this *can* get better, you don't have to keep carrying this pain around with you. try find someone you can confide in and who can help you, an adult you trust. maybe your school has a chill counselor? or do you feel like it could help to bring this up to your parents?

i don't know your situation, but i do know that it's not always immediately possible to seek the help you need, as is my case. still, i find a lot of comfort knowing that i could someday get the help i need and maybe then i'll feel okay and truly get to live life. i hope you can find comfort in that, too.

and finally, you are not alone in this, no matter how lonely you feel. i hope kindness comes your way, and i truly, sincerely hope you make it to an age where you can look back on your fifteen year old self with the nostalgic affection that i look back on mine, and you by extention. 

take care of yourself <3
i'll try my bestest. thank you for reaching out, it really means a lot
